friendlybeacons.targets.title: Affects
friendlybeacons.targets.passive.desc: Animals, villagers, fish and other non-hostile mobs.
friendlybeacons.targets.friendly.desc: Tamed pets and mounts, iron and snow golems, and allays.
friendlybeacons.targets.hostile.desc: Monsters and every other hostile mob.
friendlybeacons.radius.desc: Click to cycle the effect radius. Bigger pyramids unlock larger radii.
friendlybeacons.powers.title: Powers
friendlybeacons.powers.no_pyramid: Build a pyramid under the beacon.
friendlybeacons.powers.pending: Not applied yet: add a payment item and confirm.
friendlybeacons.bonus.title: Tier 5 bonus
friendlybeacons.bonus.both_ii.desc: Tier 5 bonus: primary and secondary powers both at level II.
friendlybeacons.bonus.both_ii.cycle: Tier 5 bonus: primary and secondary powers both at level II. Click again for the primary at level III.
friendlybeacons.bonus.primary_iii.desc: Tier 5 bonus: primary power at level III, secondary power at level I.
friendlybeacons.bonus.primary_iii.cycle: Tier 5 bonus: primary power at level III, secondary power at level I. Click again for both powers at level II.
friendlybeacons.bonus.primary_iii.resist: Resistance III is turned off in the server config.
friendlybeacons.bonus.extra.desc: Tier 5 bonus: adds this as a third power at level I.
friendlybeacons.bonus.extra.cycle: Tier 5 bonus: third power at level I. Click again for another effect.
friendlybeacons.configuration.title: Friendly Beacons Configuration
friendlybeacons.configuration.tierRadius: Maximum effect radius in blocks for pyramid tiers 1-5. Vanilla is 20, 30, 40, 50.
friendlybeacons.configuration.enableTier: Allow a 5th pyramid layer (11x11) that unlocks the tier 5 radius and bonus.
friendlybeacons.configuration.allowResis: Allow the tier 5 "primary at III" bonus to pick Resistance (60% less damage).
